City Council and Successor Agency Regular Meetings
AGENDA
MEETING OF
THE LA PUENTE CITY COUNCIL AND
SUCCESSOR AGENCY
COUNCIL CHAMBERS
15900 EAST MAIN STREET, LA PUENTE
NOVEMBER 12, 2019
07:00
P.M.
11-12-19 Agenda
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
COUNCIL/AGENCY MEMBERS: Munoz, Klinakis, Holloway, Lewis and Solis
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATIONS
Introduction of LEAD Students Attending the City Council Meeting
Presentation of Military Banner to Jose J. Gonzalez, OFS, 7th Special Forces Group (Airborne)
Presentation and Update by the San Gabriel Valley Mosquito & Vector Control District
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council - Successor Agency on an item other than a closed session and public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker's remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843.)
BOARDS/COMMISSION/COMMITTEE REPORTS
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETINGS
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETINGS OF OCTOBER 18, 2019 AND OCTOBER 22, 2019
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the City Council and Successor Agency meetings of October 18, 2019 and October 22, 2019.
A-1 Minutes 10-18-19 CC SA Park Master Plan
A-1 Minutes 10-22-19 CC SA
B.
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL – None
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL
C-1
UPDATE AND PRESENTATION REGARDING THE CITY’S ANIMAL CONTROL PROGRAM
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file this report.
C-1 Animal Control Update Staff Report
C-2
UPDATE AND PRESENTATION REGARDING THE COMMUNITY SERVICES DEPARTMENT TEENVOICE PROGRAM
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file this report.
C-2 TeenVOICE Update Staff Report
C-3
UPDATE AND PRESENTATION REGARDING THE LA PUENTE PARK MASTER PLAN
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file this report.
C-3 Park Master Plan Update Staff Report
C-4
UPDATE AND PRESENTATION ON TRAININGS AND ACTIVITIES OCCURRING IN THE MAINTENANCE/PUBLIC WORKS DIVISION
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file this report.
C-4 Maintenance Division Update Staff Report
C-5
UPDATE AND PRESENTATION REGARDING THE MEASURE M AND MEASURE R BOND ISSUANCE
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file this report.
C-5 Measure M&R Bonding Update Staff Report
D.
CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council/Successor Agency, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council/Successor Agency. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1482
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency adopt Resolution No. 19-5522 approving Warrant Register No. 1482.
D-1 Warrants Resolution #1482
D-2
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION GRANTING A FEE WAIVER FOR THE MAINTENANCE, FIELD USE, FIELD LIGHTS AND EVENT SECURITY AND ABSORBING THE COST OF THE SPECIAL EVENT INSURANCE ASSOCIATED WITH THE LA PUENTE YOUTH COALITION’S USE OF LA PUENTE PARK FOR A COMMUNITY CARNIVAL
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 19-5524 approving a request for a fee waiver for the Youth Coalition’s Carnival contingent upon the La Puente Park Athletic Field Modernization Project.
D-2 Youth Coalition Carnival Fee Waiver Staff Report
D-2 Youth Coalition Carnival Fee Waiver Attachment A Resolution
D-2 Youth Coalition Carnival Fee Waiver Attachment B Proposal
D-3
PRESENTATION OF OCTOBER 2019 REQUISITION SUMMARY REPORT
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file this report.
D-3 October Requisition Report Staff Report
D-3 October Requisition Report Attachment A Report
D-4
PRESENTATION OF GENERAL FUND BUDGET REVIEW FOR THE FIRST QUARTER OF FISCAL YEAR 2019-2020
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file this report.
D-4 First Quarter Budget Review Staff Report
D-4 First Quarter Budget Review Attachment A Revenues and Expenses
D-5
CONSIDERATION OF AMENDMENT NO. 1 TO THE LOAN AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE CITY AND THE CITY OF INDUSTRY FOR MITIGATION OF NOISE, TRAFFIC, AND RAILROAD IMPACTS ALONG VALLEY BOULEVARD TO REFLECT A REDUCED LOAN AMOUNT AND RECALCULATED REPAYMENT SCHEDULE
It is recommended that the City Council approve Amendment No. 1 to the Loan Agreement with the City of Industry.
D-5 Industry Valley Blvd Loan Amendment Staff Report
D-5 Industry Valley Blvd Loan Amendment Attachment A Amendment
D-6
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION AMENDING ADMINISTRATIVE POLICY #16, DISCRIMINATION AND HARASSMENT POLICY
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 19-5523 amending Administrative Policy #16, Discrimination and Harassment Policy.
D-6 Discrimination and Harassment Policy Staff Report
D-6 Discrimination and Harassment Policy Attachment A Resolution
D-7
SECOND READING OF: (1) AN ORDINANCE AMENDING SECTION 10.34.170 (ELECTRONIC DISPLAY BILLBOARDS) OF CHAPTER 10.34 (SIGNS) OF TITLE 10 (ZONING) OF THE LA PUENTE MUNICIPAL CODE TO ADDRESS OPERATIONAL STANDARDS FOR ELECTRONIC DISPLAY BILLBOARDS IN THE CITY; AND (2) AN ORDINANCE APPROVING DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT NO. 17-02 TO CONSTRUCT, INSTALL AND OPERATE THREE ELECTRONIC DISPLAY BILLBOARDS ON CITY-OWNED PROPERTIES AND TO CONSTRUCT AND INSTALL AN ELECTRONIC PARK SIGN AT LA PUENTE PARK FOR USE AND OPERATION BY THE CITY
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) adopt Ordinance No. 19-964, an Ordinance of the City of La Puente, California, Amending Section 10.34.170 (Electronic Display Billboards) of Chapter 10.34 (Signs) of Title 10 (Zoning) of the La Puente Municipal Code to Address Operational Standards For Electronic Display Billboards in the City; and (2) adopt Ordinance No. 19-965, an Ordinance of the City of La Puente, California, Approving Development Agreement No. 17-02 to Allow the Construction, Installation and Operation of Three Electronic Display Billboards on City-Owned Properties and to Allow the Construction and Installation of an Electronic Park Sign at La Puente Park for use and Operation by the City.
D-7 Bulletin Displays Billboards Staff Report
D-7 Bulletin Displays Billboards Attachment A Ordinance Billboard Standards
D-7 Bulletin Displays Billboards Attachment B Ordinance DA
D-8
CONSIDERATION OF AMENDMENT NO. 1 TO THE MAINTENANCE SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH TANKO LIGHTING, INC. FOR STREET LIGHT MAINTENANCE TO EXTEND THE TERM FOR AN ADDITIONAL YEAR
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve Amendment No. 1 to the Maintenance Services Agreement with Tanko Lighting, Inc.; and (2) authorize the City Manager to execute the Amendment on behalf of the City.
D-8 Tanko Maintenance Services Amendment Staff Report
D-8 Tanko Maintenance Services Amendment Attachment A
D-9
CONSIDERATION OF RELEASE OF BONDS FOR TRACT MAP NO. 73749 LOCATED AT 747 DEL VALLE AVENUE – BRANDYWINE HOMES
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) accept the public improvements completed for Tract Map No. 73749; (2) authorize the City Clerk to execute a Notice of Completion; and (3) authorize staff to release the Faithful Performance Bond, Material and Labor Bond, and Warranty Bond to the developer.
D-9 747 Del Valle Release Bond Staff Report
D-9 747 Del Valle Release Bond Attachment A SIA
D-9 747 Del Valle Release Bond Attachment B Bonds
D-10
CONSIDERATION OF A PURCHASE ORDER CONTRACT WITH WILLDAN ENGINEERING TO EXTEND INTERIM PLANNING CONSULTANT SERVICES IN THE AMOUNT OF $17,250.00
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve the purchase order contract with Willdan Engineering for interim planning services; (2) authorize the City Manager to execute the proposal on behalf of the City.
D-10 Willdan Interim Planning Services Staff Report
D-10 Willdan Interim Planning Services Attachment A Proposal
D-11
CONSIDERATION OF A PURCHASE ORDER CONTRACT WITH CREATIVE BUS SALES FOR THE PURCHASE OF A 2019 STARCRAFT ALLSTAR CUTAWAY BUS IN THE AMOUNT OF $105,050.75
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve the purchase order contract with Creative Bus Sales for purchase of one 2019 Starcraft Allstar Cutaway Bus; and (2) authorize the City Manager to execute, on behalf of the City, all documents necessary to effectuate this action.
D-11 Creative Bus Sales Starcraft Staff Report
D-11 Creative Bus Sales Starcraft Attachment A Quote
D-12
SECOND READING OF AN ORDINANCE TO AMEND TABLE 2-5 (CM ZONE-ALLOWED USES AND PERMIT REQUIREMENTS) OF SECTION 10.14.020 (LAND USE REGULATIONS) OF CHAPTER 10.14 (COMMERCIAL-MANUFACTURING ZONE) OF ARTICLE 2 (ZONES, ALLOWABLE USES AND DEVELOPMENT AND DESIGN STANDARDS) OF TITLE 10 (ZONING) OF THE LA PUENTE MUNICIPAL CODE TO ALLOW BANQUET FACILITY USES IN THE COMMERCIAL MANUFACTURING ZONE SUBJECT TO APPROVAL OF A CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT, ADOPT ASSOCIATED MUNICIPAL CODE AMENDMENTS TO ACCOMMODATE SAID USE, AND ADOPT A NEGATIVE DECLARATION REGARDING SAME
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Ordinance No. 19-963, an Ordinance of the City Council of the City of La Puente amending Table 2-5 (CM Zone-allowed Uses and Permit Requirements) of Section 10.14.020 (Land Use Regulations) of Chapter 10.14 (Commercial-Manufacturing Zone) of Article 2 (Zones, Allowable Uses and Development and Design Standards) of Title 10 (Zoning) of the La Puente Municipal Code to allow banquet facility uses in the Commercial Manufacturing zone subject to approval of a Conditional Use Permit, adopt associated municipal code amendments to accommodate said use, and adopt the IS/ND regarding same.
D-12 MCA 145 Banquet Facilities Staff Report
D-12 MCA 145 Banquet Facilities Attachment A Ordinance
D-13
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION RESCINDING RESOLUTION NO. 19-5506 AND AMENDING THE COMPREHENSIVE PERSONNEL SYSTEM FOR FULL-TIME POSITIONS TO CHANGE ONE OF THE MAINTENANCE WORKER POSITIONS TO A MAINTENANCE LEAD POSITION
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 19-5526 rescinding Resolution No. 19-5506 and approving authorized full-time positions and salary ranges.
D-13 Salary Resolution Maint Lead Staff Report
D-13 Salary Resolution Maint Lead Attachment A Resolution
D-13 Salary Resolution Maint Lead Attachment B Description
D-14
CONSIDERATION OF AMENDMENT NO. 1 TO THE EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT WITH ROBERT C. LINDSEY FOR CITY MANAGER SERVICES
It is recommended that the City Council provide direction to Staff.
D-14 City Manager Lindsey Contract Staff Report
D-14 City Manager Lindsey Contract Attachment A Amendment
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-1
DISCUSSION AND DIRECTION REGARDING THE CITY’S YOUTH ACTIVITIES GRANT PROGRAM (COUNCIL MEMBER SOLIS)
It is recommended that the City Council discuss the Youth Activities Grant Program and provide direction to Staff.
E-1 Youth Activities Grant Program Staff Report
E-1 Youth Activities Grant Program Attachment A Guidelines
E-2
CONSIDERATION OF STREET USE AGREEMENT AND FEE WAIVER FOR THE OLD TOWN PUENTE ASSOCIATION’S ANNUAL HOLIDAY STREET FAIR
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve the Street Use Agreement for the Old Town Puente Association’s Annual Holiday Street Fair; and (2) provide direction regarding the request for a fee waiver for the Old Town Puente Association’s Holiday Street Fair in the amount of $12,250.
E-2 Old Town Puente Street Use Agreement Staff Report
E-2 Old Town Puente Street Use Agreement Attachment A Agreement
E-2 Old Town Puente Street Use Agreement Attachment B Resolution
E-3
DISCUSSION AND DIRECTION REGARDING NAMING RIGHTS FOR THE LA PUENTE SKATE PARK (MAYOR MUNOZ)
It is recommended that the City Council discuss naming rights for the La Puente Skate Park and provide direction to Staff.
E-3 Skate Park Naming Rights Staff Report
E-3 Skate Park Naming Rights Attachment A Policy
ADHOC COMMITTEE REPORTS
AB 1234 REPORTS
ORAL COMMENTS FROM COUNCIL
ORAL COMMENTS FROM STAFF
ADJOURNMENT
AVAILABILITY
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Successor Agency regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at City Hall located at 15900 E. Main Street, the La Puente Community Center located at 501 North Glendora and the Los Angeles County Library located at 15920 E. Central. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org.
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
CERTIFICATION
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury, under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted in accordance with the applicable legal requirements.
Dated this 8th day of November, 2019
___________________________________
City Clerk
